items.title: Jimmy Owens — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My father was James Roberts Owens, he was born in New York City.

ctx.x: Okay, very good. Let’s begin with the Bronx. Let’s begin with your parents. Could you state your parents’ names and where they were from?

My father was James Roberts Owens, he was born in New York City. My mother is Eva Louis Noisette Owens, and she was born Charleston, South Carolina. Her birthday is November 10th, 1911. My father is June 17th, 1911. My father passed away in 2004, and my mother passed away in 2002.
